citation: O'Hare, L., Stark, P., Cockerill, M., Lloyd, K., McConnellogue, S., Gildea, A., Biggart, A., Connolly, P., & Bower, C. (2019). Reciprocal Reading: Evaluation report and executive summary. London: Education Endowment Foundation (Centre for Evidence and Social Innovation, Queen's University Belfast). September 2019.
report_number: EEF project: FFT Literacy Reciprocal Reading (efficacy trial; QUB CESI evaluation, September 2019)
design: Cluster RCT (assignment = School, minimisation on reading comprehension, reading accuracy, school-level %FSM); 98 schools randomised (51 intervention/49 control; 2 intervention schools later excluded -> 49/49); efficacy/developer-led trial; business-as-usual control. Two intervention versions delivered in the same schools to different year groups: UNIVERSAL whole-class for Year 4 (ages 8-9; targeted_population=All) and TARGETED small-group for selected poor-comprehenders in Years 5-6 (ages 9-11). Subject: reading/literacy. Outcome: New Group Reading Test (NGRT). Immediate post-test after ~1 academic year.
problems: IDENTITY/GRADE-BAND MISMATCH: The registry (row 85) records grade band 'K-2', but this trial covers Year 4 (universal, ages 8-9) and Years 5-6 (targeted, ages 9-11), which map to the 3-6 band, NOT K-2. The registry grade-band code appears to be an error; this is nonetheless the only O'Hare-et-al.-2019 student-achievement TPD-vs-control RCT (confirmed via OpenAlex author A5052669662: his other 2019 outputs are SMART Spaces [secondary science spaced-learning], the PAX Good Behaviour Game prosocial-behaviour efficacy trial [cooperation-based, non-achievement], and Doodle Den is 2020). The meta-analysis coded the study as single-arm (is_multi_arm=0) with targeted_population='All', which best matches the UNIVERSAL (whole-class Year 4) arm; the targeted arm serves a non-randomly pre-selected subgroup of poor comprehenders ('Specific' population) so is flagged is_full_sample=false. I extracted all four primary-outcome contrasts (both arms x overall-reading + comprehension) and labelled them so central merge can pick the universal arm if needed. Hedges' g, 95% CIs, and Ns are taken directly from the report's detailed primary-analysis tables (Table 13 universal, Table 14 targeted; also exec-summary Table 1). g was computed by the authors as the multilevel ANCOVA group coefficient / pooled SD where the SD accounts for clustering (Connolly et al. 2017 method), using pretest-adjusted post-test means -> cluster_adjusted=true, pretest_adjusted=true. Impact SE not printed directly; derived from the reported 95% CI (SE = CI width / (2*1.95996)); g_var = SE^2. mean_t/mean_c/sd_t/sd_c recorded are the RAW post-test means/SDs from the tables (the report prints raw means for comparison but standardised g on adjusted means; so g is NOT a simple recompute of raw means). ICC recorded is the analysis-stage school-level ICC from the overall-reading primary model (Universal 0.06, Targeted 0.15; design-stage estimate was 0.14) -- comprehension-specific analysis-stage ICCs not separately printed, so the overall-reading ICC is used for both outcomes within each arm. n_clusters=94 (47 int/47 ctrl) at analysis stage. NGRT is a nationally standardised, independently published adaptive commercial test (GL Assessment, standardised 2014, n=4960) -> standardized_independent. 'Overall reading ability' (47-item total score) is an aggregate that subsumes 'Reading comprehension' (27-item subscale) per the report's multiple-testing discussion -> overall=composite, comprehension=subscale.

effect_sizes.arm_label: FFT Literacy Reciprocal Reading - UNIVERSAL (whole-class, Year 4) arm vs business-as-usual control [best match to registry row 85: targeted_population=All]
effect_sizes.test_name: New Group Reading Test (NGRT) - overall reading ability (total score, 47 items)
effect_sizes.timepoint: post (end of ~1 academic year of intervention)
effect_sizes.g_method: Hedges' g reported directly by authors (Table 13): multilevel ANCOVA group coefficient / pooled SD, SD computed accounting for clustering (Connolly et al. 2017: SD = SE_group * sqrt(N_group) from a null mixed model), on pretest-adjusted post-test means. Taken directly as g. SE derived from reported 95% CI (-0.06, 0.07): SE = (0.07-(-0.06))/(2*1.95996); g_var = SE^2. mean/sd fields are RAW post-test values (report prints raw means; g standardised on adjusted means).

effect_sizes.notes: Universal whole-class arm, full Year 4 sample. Reading -> Reading per spec. N in model 3198 (1666 int; 1532 ctrl). p=0.795 (no significant effect). 'Overall reading' total score subsumes the comprehension subscale (composite). icc=0.06 = analysis-stage school-level ICC from overall-reading model.
